qualification.scope: Owned headless Edge pages and both bundle sources. Trusted keyboard input and actual outgoing runtime message payloads. Sixteen final cases; ten original baseline cases failed before the fix; six controls added afterward.
qualification.regressionScope: Eight runs of four unique scripts. Keyboard, controls and ad-ready use family selection; source-race internally tests both sources and was run twice.
qualification.limitations: Generic site catalog update cases, not public YouTube catalog delivery, native handoff or complete-file assembly. No Firefox engine, physical DPI/zoom, installed acceptance or fresh paired IDM geometry/timing. Screenshot viewport 1200 by 800.
